start: Today, the list 'Talk to these members' with at least one member

steps.action: Tap 'Message' at the right end of a member’s row
user_sees: A new tab: WhatsApp opens a chat with that member’s number, with an empty message box
Hovering the link first shows 'WhatsApp <the member’s phone number>'
must_not: Any message sent by itself
A chat with another member’s number
Today replaced by WhatsApp in the same tab

steps.action: Come back to the admin app tab
must_not: The member marked as messaged or moved off the list

start: Other kind: the rows of 'Money to collect' and of 'Losing the habit'

steps.action: Tap 'Message' on a row of 'Money to collect'
user_sees: WhatsApp opens a chat with that member; the message box is empty (no fees text is filled in from here)
must_not: An amount or a pay link sent without the user typing it

steps.action: Tap 'Message' on a row of 'Losing the habit'
user_sees: WhatsApp opens a chat with that member; the message box is empty
must_not: A chat with the wrong member

start: Negative: a member whose saved phone number is empty or not a full number

user_sees: unknown: the link is built from the digits of the saved number with no check (Today.tsx:653); what WhatsApp shows for an empty or short number was not driven
must_not: A chat opened with a stranger’s number
A dead link with no word to the user

steps.action: Tap 'Message', close WhatsApp without sending, tap 'Message' again
user_sees: The same empty chat again; Today unchanged both times
must_not: A record in the admin app that a message was sent
The row greyed out or removed

start: Privacy and promise: a member’s phone number leaves the admin app for WhatsApp

steps.action: Tap 'Message' and look at what was handed to WhatsApp
user_sees: Only that one member’s phone number, in the link; the user’s own WhatsApp account does the talking
must_not: The member’s name, dues or plan passed in the link
Other members’ numbers passed
The admin app’s address passed on to WhatsApp as the referring page
